mapper.insert: insert into user ( username, password, age, email, create_time ) values ( #{username}, #{password}, #{age}, #{email}, #{createTime} )
mapper.select: select id, username, password, age, email, create_time from user where id = #{id}
select id, username, password, age, email, create_time from user order by id asc
mapper.update: update user set username = #{username}, password = #{password}, age = #{age}, email = #{email} where id = #{id}
